scope: One PDF reader/writer library with its embedded TTF helper; existing zlib reused. No renderer or standalone interpreter.

components.license: Apache-2.0 with optional exceptions; embedded MD5 Zlib-style and SHA-256 BSD-3-Clause notices; CC0-1.0 ICC data
components.purpose: Read/write external PDF documents, objects, pages, streams, metadata; page copy; font/image embedding. No rendering.
components.selected_profile: Hosted C99 static library, 17 production translation units including embedded TTF, zlib stream compression, built-in PNG path, no libpng or libjpeg dependency; POSIX APIs on Unix and retained Win32 branches.
optional_not_linked: libjpeg; JPEG compressed data is embedded without a libjpeg dependency

embedded_components.name: TTF helper
embedded_components.version: Exact source embedded in PDFio v1.6.6; no submodule fetch required

embedded_components.name: MD5 implementation
embedded_components.license: Zlib-style permissive notice, L. Peter Deutsch / Aladdin Enterprises

excluded_copyleft_assets: examples/code128.ttf (GPL-2.0 font) and its license; dependent optional code128 example excluded together. No production dependency on this font.
components.state_and_reentrancy: Files/objects/streams use per-file mutable state and allocator/file buffers. Serialize all access to each file, including reads. localeconv accesses process locale; do not change locale concurrently. Cross-file concurrency was not tested, and code sharing is not a claim that C or libc state is immutable.

build_view_adjustments.change: One explicit (const double (*)[3]) matrix cast at pdfioArrayCreateColorFromMatrix call inside pdfioArrayCreateColorFromPrimaries. Original vendor bytes unchanged.
build_view_adjustments.reason: ISO C before C23 does not allow the implicit multidimensional-array pointer qualification conversion; GCC -std=c99 -pedantic-errors rejects it.

components.validation: VERIFICATION.json: original-tree and trimmed-tree strict C99 builds, identical .a, three explicitly scoped offline checks plus ASan/UBSan. Encrypted CreationDate has a separately retained KNOWN_FAIL reproducer; encrypted profile not fully verified.
known_limitations: Encrypted CreationDate is read as 0 instead of the written timestamp; KNOWN_FAIL, no semantic fix applied.
AES-256 is an upstream TODO, not claimed.
Not a PDF renderer; not all filter/font/image/corpus combinations validated.
